items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: When I joined Duke Ellington in the Cotton Club, it was Arthur Whetsol, Freddie Wetzel, Phil Jenkins, Cootie Williams

ctx.x: That's okay, it's probably written down someplace. Who was in Duke's band when you joined it?

When I joined Duke Ellington in the Cotton Club, it was Arthur Whetsol, Freddie Wetzel, Phil Jenkins, Cootie Williams, Freddie Guy, a guitar player, and we had Otto Hardwick, Hiwork, saxophone, Johnny Hodges, and Carney, and on the drums was Sonny Greer, and the bass player was that fellow from New Orleans, what's his name?

items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: He came in after me, though.

ctx.x: I don't think it was ever remade or anything. But anyway, it was first. But in April in 1930, that was a very good session. And incidentally, Tizol Teazle came in the band in '29. Last time, when you and I talked about it, I thought Teazle came quite a bit later than that, but he must have come in about the same time you did.
He came in after me, though.
